provenance.baseStats: S04-2 row 2, player-measured table; not official client configuration

localAdaptation.chanceResolution: One independent threshold roll per valid basic attack attempt, including later evaded or immune attacks
localAdaptation.randomStream: Hash of both opening armies plus UID and attempt count; battle-local, no campaign RNG consumption
localAdaptation.charm: Passive remains active while attacking original allies
localAdaptation.criticalInteraction: Basic attack armor, shield, evasion, shred, lifesteal and reflection apply normally
localAdaptation.caveat: Client screenshot displays 60s cooldown while its prose and S04 identify a passive. Its functional meaning is unresolved. This project uses an always-available on-attack passive without a 60s gate; exact trigger boundaries and RNG are local choices. Sources span dates, not a unified official ruleset.
